cause_claim: The change adds GRANT SELECT ON r0.* to svc_bundle_reader, which causes the bundle-builder to read both default.bundle_fields (99 rows) and r0.bundle_fields (99 rows), doubling the bundle from 99 to 198 entries (3118→6187 bytes). However, worker-runtime exits with code 0 in both baseline and candidate, showing the increased bundle size does not violate any runtime limits.
